category: アクセス制御、データ保護、インシデント対応
title: External accounts and encryption
prompt: S3 GetObject is allowed for a role in an external account, but a decryption-permission error occurs for data encrypted with SSE-KMS using a customer managed KMS key. What should you check?

choices.text: Check only GetObject for the external role.
choices.explanation: Object-read permission alone does not grant permission to decrypt with KMS.

choices.text: Check the permission on the key owner's side and the reading role's kms:Decrypt permission.
choices.explanation: For cross-account access, check both the key policy and the IAM permissions of the role using the key.

choices.text: Register the external account ID in CORS.
choices.explanation: CORS concerns browser origins; it does not control KMS access.

learning.reason: For cross-account access, check both the key policy and the IAM permissions of the principal using the key.
learning.concept: When troubleshooting, first identify which key encrypted the object.

title: Bucket Access from the Organization
prompt: Even when new accounts are added to the organization, you want to restrict the Allow in the bucket policy to IAM principals from your own organization. Which condition key should you use?

choices.explanation: This condition concerns the Region in which the API request is made and does not identify the principal's organization.
This condition can determine the organization to which the calling principal's account belongs.
This condition identifies the principal type, but it cannot exclude principals of the same type from other organizations.

learning.reason: It can determine the organization to which the calling principal's account belongs.
learning.concept: An organization condition is one boundary. Also restrict the required actions, target prefixes, and principal roles.

title: Centralized Audit of Operations
prompt: Even when member accounts are added, you want to aggregate management events to the organization's log destination. You do not want member administrators to modify the organization's trail.

choices.text: Send only VPC Flow Logs from each subnet
choices.explanation: These are network traffic logs and do not record management API calls such as IAM operations.

choices.text: Review each member's event history individually
choices.explanation: This requires checking each environment separately and does not configure delivery to a shared organizational log destination.
It applies the trail to the relevant members and can be managed at the organization level.

learning.reason: It applies the trail to the relevant members and can be managed at the organization level.
learning.concept: In addition to an organization trail, design the destination bucket policy and log-retention method.

title: Detecting External Sharing
prompt: You want to continuously identify whether an S3 bucket has a policy that permits access by principals outside the trusted zone.

choices.explanation: This service does not evaluate external sharing.
This manages data versions; it does not compare policies for external sharing.

choices.text: Use the IAM Access Analyzer external access analyzer
choices.explanation: It can analyze external access that resource policies allow by configuration.

learning.reason: It can analyze external access that resource policies allow by configuration.
learning.concept: Distinguish the possibility of external access from evidence that access actually occurred.

title: S3 Retention
prompt: You want object versions containing audit logs to be undeletable for a specified period, even by the root user.

choices.explanation: This does not prohibit deletion that explicitly specifies a version.

choices.text: Use Object Lock in compliance mode
choices.explanation: Protected versions cannot be deleted during the retention period, and the retention period cannot be shortened.

choices.text: Use only Object Lock in governance mode
choices.explanation: A principal with the appropriate permissions can bypass governance retention.

learning.reason: Protected versions cannot be deleted during the retention period, and the retention period cannot be shortened.
learning.concept: Protection applies to individual versions. Distinguish the object name currently displayed from the protected object version.

title: Detecting Malicious Activity
prompt: You want to detect suspicious API usage and network behavior in an AWS account and obtain findings for investigation.

choices.text: Move the account to an OU in AWS Organizations
choices.explanation: Hierarchical management alone does not enable threat detection.

choices.text: Use AWS Config to inspect only required tags
choices.explanation: This checks static configuration compliance, not suspicious API behavior.
It detects threats from relevant data sources and generates Findings.

learning.reason: It detects threats from relevant data sources and generates Findings.
learning.concept: Define separate investigation and isolation procedures for findings received from GuardDuty.
